header: The page's whole-game plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, about 70 minutes: a long play, for finding
what the regular plans don't reach (a stutter, a missed shader, an error in a level they never play), not for
every change. It boots and starts file A as tools/play_plan.json does, then plays every course's six acts, the
secret stages' stars and the three Bowser stages in about the order a player meets them, and the ending to the
end of the credits. Each act is warped into from the castle by tools/shader_survey.js as its painting does, its act
picked at the act select (pickAct) and taken with A, and about 12 s of the game's time played from where the act
starts Mario (where a step off the start is a fall, the camera and jumps only). Then the survey puts the act's star
where Mario stands (star(n), patches/shader_survey.c), and he collects it as a player does: its dance, the course's
end and the save dialog, passed with A, back in the castle. The save file's stars are the ones the plan took, so the
act select and the castle show the game's own progress. Each Bowser stage is played, its pipe taken (a warp to the
fight, as the pipe makes) and Bowser beaten there by the survey (killBowser, nearBowser), his key or the grand star
taken. A shot at each act's end and through the credits; Mario kept at full health and given four lives an act.
